derived_from.section: Work package W5 — Shadow policy and lifecycle reconciliation
derived_from.note: Refinement of the approved plan section into machine-readable criteria. No product scope is added, removed, or reinterpreted; every criterion traces to a plan line.

commit: feat(optimizer): default to shadow mode and reconcile stale lifecycle rows

prior_art_to_reuse_not_duplicate.org_proposal_recovery_service.ts: W1 package C already ships a bounded recovery sweep that ACTS: it re-projects lagging profiles and durably marks incoherent approved/applied claims. W5's reconciler is a distinct, strictly READ-ONLY classifier over ACTIVE scope rows for operator reporting. Do not merge the two and do not give the reconciler write powers.
prior_art_to_reuse_not_duplicate.markMeasuringUnresolvable: W1 package C already converts permanently-unprovable measuring rows to reconciliation-required. W5 step 10 covers the remaining case: rows that are legitimately RETRYABLE (telemetry unavailable, engine down) and today retry forever with no accounting.

criteria.plan_line: policy parser defaults to shadow, accepts only off | shadow | human_only | auto, and rejects invalid values to the safest mode
criteria.text: The parser is pure. Absent, empty, misspelled, wrong-case, or hostile values all resolve to shadow, never to auto. Only the four listed values are accepted.

criteria.plan_line: expose kill switches per change family
criteria.text: Each change family can be independently disabled, and a disabled family is refused regardless of the global mode.

criteria.plan_line: optimizer shadow run still audits/generates/ranks proposals but calls no apply, measure, revert, install, or target writer
criteria.text: In shadow mode a run produces proposals and counters, and performs ZERO of: applyProposal, measureProposal, revertProposal, tool install, agent_configs write, profile projection. Asserted by spying every one of those seams, not by reading a flag.

criteria.plan_line: preserving result counters that identify shadow candidates
criteria.text: A shadow run still reports what it WOULD have done, so the counters distinguish a shadow candidate from an absence of candidates.

criteria.plan_line: reconciler classifies active scope rows as effective, reintroduced/drifted, unsafe legacy rollback, conflicted, or unverifiable
criteria.text: Exactly those five classifications, decided from the current config and the versioned snapshot. A row that cannot be proven is unverifiable, never assumed effective.

criteria.plan_line: implement read-only reconciliation against current config and versioned snapshots
criteria.text: The reconciler performs no writes of any kind. Asserted by running it against a fixture and comparing a full before/after snapshot of both agent_configs and agent_org_proposals.

criteria.plan_line: operator script prints stable JSON and mutates nothing without --apply
criteria.text: Default invocation is dry-run, emits deterministic JSON, and changes nothing.

criteria.plan_line: --apply may only retire/supersede stale metadata; it must never restore/remove permissions automatically
criteria.text: With --apply the script may only mark proposal metadata retired/superseded. It must never write allowedMcpsJson, allowedSkillsJson, or corePermissionsJson. Asserted by comparing target scope bytes before and after an --apply run.

criteria.plan_line: measuring rows gain retry/deadline accounting or a deterministic inconclusive classification rather than indefinite silent retry
criteria.text: A retryable measuring row accumulates attempt/deadline accounting, and once past its budget becomes deterministically inconclusive and inspectable instead of retrying forever in silence.

criteria.plan_line: Reconciler reports the 69 legacy rows safely without changing config
criteria.text: Given the live-audit shape recorded in the plan (legacy whole-field snapshots on active rows), the reconciler classifies them as unsafe legacy rollback and changes no config.

acceptance_gates: Shadow mode has zero mutation side effects.
Reconciler reports the legacy rows safely without changing config.
Dry-run is the default and permission restoration/removal is never automated.
Stuck measuring work becomes inspectable/inconclusive instead of eternal.
explicitly_out_of_scope: Any automatic permission restoration or removal (plan: Deferred by design).
Requester-only canary enablement (plan: Deferred by design).
Consuming the outcome ledger — that is W6.
